name: Whispering Canopy
description: A dark, ancient forest shrouded in twilight. Towering trees weave together a thick whispering canopy that blocks the sun, concealing ancient threats.
visualTheme: Twilight-shrouded woodlands where glowing moss outlines gnarled pathways and a low mist clings to the soil.

history.createdWhy: Formed over millennia by wild magic seeping from the Leyline Nexus.
history.builtWho: An uninhabited wilderness, though ancient druids once maintained shrines here.
history.majorEvents: Corrupted by the shadow curse following the fall of the Nameless Citadel.
history.whyExists: Acts as a buffer zone between civilization and the wild depths of the world.
history.currentConflicts: The spreading blight is turning native beasts into aggressive monsters.

ecosystem.weather: Dense purple mist and cold wind

npcs.name: Druid Miriel
dialogue: The trees weep... their roots taste shadow.
Do not stray from the glowing paths. The mist claims the unwary.
I sense a deep disturbance beneath the watchtower.

secrets.name: Leyline Rift
secrets.description: A minor fissure of pulsing arcane energy hidden beneath a hollow tree.
